independence_instructions: This is an AI-assisted audit and does not satisfy the independent-human annotation requirement.
Use only public task, quality, scenario, metric, overlay, source, and test evidence.
Do not inspect reference branches, solution patches, or model-generated answers.
rationale: Pexpect naturally separates search matching, SpawnBase state, transport behavior, and high-level wrappers. EOF, TIMEOUT, bytes/text, buffer, before/after, and match contracts can become stale across workers and are covered by a frozen POSIX evaluator. The writable scopes are suitable, but the spawn-to-wrapper metric currently attributes transport files to the spawn producer and should be split or corrected before cross-agent CAIL attribution.
